name: Controlled failure — no false success
description: Two controlled failures the system already defines. First, the scenario handler reads a workspace file that does not exist: the Hotkey Runtime classifies the thrown error as EXECUTION_ERROR and the Agent reports EXECUTION_FAILED, and the workspace stays untouched (no half-written file). Second, an explicitly declared harness fault makes the composer's report bus refuse: the run becomes REPORT_FAILED with no report artifact at all. Both must stay non-success.

plan.task: Save a workspace note that does not exist

changes.why: attempt a save against a missing workspace file

verification: read back the workspace and confirm nothing was written
risks: a failed execution must never be reported as a success

args.entry: - RT-005: this entry must never be written
